newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hostages all released in Paris siege - police.
newsitem.headline: Hostages all released in Paris siege - police.

text.p: All 35 people held hostage on Friday by an armed man in central Paris have been set free, a police official said.
"All of the hostages have been released," the official told Reuters.
"The police will now proceed with an investigation," the official added.

A 55-year-old man with a grievance against his former employer, the ADC security delivery firm, had taken the group hostage on the third floor of a building on Boulevard Haussmann, a busy downtown street, police had said earlier.
Two people were shot in the incident and taken to hospital, they said.
